brief:
The Israeli occupation authority has closed the Ibrahimi Mosque in Hebron for three days, citing Jewish holidays as the reason for the restriction, the Ma'an news agency reported. The closure prevents Palestinian worshippers from accessing the holy site during the period.

The Ibrahimi Mosque, one of Islam's holiest shrines, is regularly subject to restrictions and closures that limit Palestinian access while permitting Israeli settlers and visitors to enter the compound.
title: Israeli military closes Ibrahimi Mosque for three days citing Jewish holidays
